core_obligations: Prove the equivalence of: (1) Supp(F) is proper over Y; (2) the scheme-theoretic support of F is proper over Y; (3) there is a closed subspace Z of X proper over Y and a finite type quasi-coherent O_Z-module G with (Z -> X)_*G = F
proof_roadmap: The support is closed, so properness over Y makes sense for it; the scheme-theoretic support has the same underlying topological space, making (1) and (2) equivalent by definition.
Statement (2) gives (3) by taking Z to be the scheme-theoretic support and G the module F viewed over it.
Conversely, (3) puts Supp(F) inside the closed subset |Z| proper over Y, and the closed-subset lemma transfers properness to Supp(F).
difficulty_reason: H2: a three-way equivalence unwinding definitions with one support-containment argument.
